Script.name: ASCII Map Capture
Script.script:
-- Boundary-driven capture for server-tagged room and wilderness maps. -- A permanent trigger calls processLine() for every logical line, avoiding the -- version-dependent scheduling of temporary line triggers created mid-stream. GUI.AsciiMapCapture = GUI.AsciiMapCapture or {} local Capture = GUI.AsciiMapCapture local TIMEOUT_NAME = "asciiMapCapture.inactivity" local TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 5 local MAX_ROWS = 64 local MAX_COLUMNS = 256 local MAX_BYTES = 131072 local function allowedCharacters(characters) local allowed = {} for index = 1, #characters do allowed[characters:sub(index, index)] = true end return allowed end local MAP_KINDS = { room = { opening = "<ROOM_MAP>", closing = "</ROOM_MAP>", allowed = allowedCharacters([[ [].,Y^m~=UX|-+o`MCi&A:*?\/S#]]), padding = function() return 1 end, fit = function(columns, rows) if map and type(map.adjustAsciimapFontSize) == "function" then return map.adjustAsciimapFontSize(columns, rows) end end, }, wilderness = { opening = "<WILDERNESS_MAP>", closing = "</WILDERNESS_MAP>", allowed = allowedCharacters([[ [].,Yn^~=UX|-+M*CA:&S?#\/]]), padding = function() if not map or type(map.calcMinimapPadding) ~= "function" then return 0 end local ok, value = pcall(map.calcMinimapPadding) if not ok then return 0 end return math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(value) or 0)) end, fit = function(columns, rows) if map and type(map.adjustMinimapFontSize) == "function" then return map.adjustMinimapFontSize(columns, rows) end end, }, } local function logDebug(message, detail) if type(GUI.debug) == "function" then GUI.debug("ASCII_MAP_CAPTURE", message, detail) end end local function logError(message) if type(GUI.debugError) == "function" then GUI.debugError("ASCII_MAP_CAPTURE", message) end end local function cancelLegacyTrigger() if not map or not map.maplineTrig then return false end local triggerId = map.maplineTrig map.maplineTrig = nil if type(exists) ~= "function" or type(killTrigger) ~= "function" then return false end local checked, present = pcall(exists, triggerId, "trigger") if checked and present ~= 0 then local killed = pcall(killTrigger, triggerId) return killed end return false end function Capture.reset(reason) local previous = Capture.state Capture.state = nil if type(GUI.cancelOwnedTimer) == "function" then GUI.cancelOwnedTimer(TIMEOUT_NAME) end cancelLegacyTrigger() if previous then logDebug("capture reset", { reason = reason, kind = previous.kind, rows = previous.rows, bytes = previous.bytes, }) end return previous ~= nil end local function destinationReady() return map ~= nil and map.minimap ~= nil and type(map.minimap.echo) == "function" and type(clearUserWindow) == "function" and type(selectCurrentLine) == "function" and type(copy) == "function" and type(appendBuffer) == "function" and type(deleteLine) == "function" end local function scheduleTimeout(state) if type(GUI.setOwnedTimer) ~= "function" then return false end local timerId = GUI.setOwnedTimer("asciiMapCapture.inactivity", TIMEOUT_SECONDS, function() if Capture.state == state then Capture.reset("inactivity timeout") end end) return timerId ~= nil end local function setMapVisibility(kind) if kind == "wilderness" then if map.container and type(map.container.hide) == "function" then pcall(map.container.hide, map.container) end if GUI.asciiMapContainer and type(GUI.asciiMapContainer.show) == "function" then pcall(GUI.asciiMapContainer.show, GUI.asciiMapContainer) end return end local mode = GUI.buttonWindow and GUI.buttonWindow.mudletOrAscii if mode == "ASCII" then if map.container and type(map.container.hide) == "function" then pcall(map.container.hide, map.container) end if GUI.asciiMapContainer and type(GUI.asciiMapContainer.show) == "function" then pcall(GUI.asciiMapContainer.show, GUI.asciiMapContainer) end elseif mode == "Mudlet" then if map.container and type(map.container.show) == "function" then pcall(map.container.show, map.container) end if GUI.asciiMapContainer and type(GUI.asciiMapContainer.hide) == "function" then pcall(GUI.asciiMapContainer.hide, GUI.asciiMapContainer) end end end
local function beginCapture(kind) Capture.reset("new " .. kind .. " map") if not destinationReady() then logError("map destination is unavailable; leaving opening marker visible") return false end
local config = MAP_KINDS[kind] local state = { kind = kind, config = config, rows = 0, bytes = 0, width = 0, padding = config.padding(), } Capture.state = state if not scheduleTimeout(state) then Capture.reset("could not create inactivity timer") logError("could not create map inactivity timer") return false end
local cleared, clearResult = pcall(clearUserWindow, "map.minimap") if not cleared or clearResult == false then Capture.reset("could not clear destination") logError("could not clear map destination: " .. tostring(clearResult)) return false end
setMapVisibility(kind) local deleted, deleteError = pcall(deleteLine) if not deleted then Capture.reset("could not consume opening marker") logError("could not consume opening marker: " .. tostring(deleteError)) return false end
logDebug("capture started", {kind = kind, padding = state.padding}) return true end
local function validRow(state, text) if #text > MAX_COLUMNS then return false, "row width exceeds safety limit" end for index = 1, #text do if not state.config.allowed[text:sub(index, index)] then return false, "row contains a character that is invalid for " .. state.kind .. " maps" end end if text ~= "" and state.width ~= 0 and #text ~= state.width then return false, "row width changed inside map block" end return true end
local function transferRow(state, text) if not destinationReady() then return false, "map destination disappeared" end if state.rows + 1 > MAX_ROWS then return false, "row count exceeds safety limit" end if state.bytes + #text + 1 > MAX_BYTES then return false, "map byte count exceeds safety limit" end
local valid, validationError = validRow(state, text) if not valid then return false, validationError end if not scheduleTimeout(state) then return false, "could not refresh inactivity timer" end
local transferred, transferError = xpcall(function() if text == "" then map.minimap:echo(string.rep(" ", state.padding) .. "\n") else selectCurrentLine() copy() if state.padding > 0 then map.minimap:echo(string.rep(" ", state.padding)) end local appended = appendBuffer("map.minimap") if appended == false then error("appendBuffer returned false") end end end, debug.traceback) if not transferred then return false, transferError end
local deleted, deleteError = pcall(deleteLine) if not deleted then return false, deleteError end state.rows = state.rows + 1 state.bytes = state.bytes + #text + 1 state.width = math.max(state.width, #text) return true end
local function finishCapture(state) local columns = math.max(1, state.width + state.padding) local rows = math.max(1, state.rows) local fitted, fitError = pcall(state.config.fit, columns, rows) if not fitted then logError("could not fit completed map: " .. tostring(fitError)) end logDebug("capture completed", { kind = state.kind, rows = state.rows, width = state.width, padding = state.padding, }) Capture.reset("map completed") end
function Capture.processLine(text) if type(text) ~= "string" then if Capture.state then Capture.reset("missing incoming line") end return "ignored" end
for kind, config in pairs(MAP_KINDS) do if text == config.opening then return beginCapture(kind) and "started" or "ignored" end end
local state = Capture.state if not state then return "ignored" end
if text == state.config.closing then local deleted, deleteError = pcall(deleteLine) if not deleted then Capture.reset("could not consume closing marker") logError("could not consume closing marker: " .. tostring(deleteError)) return "aborted" end finishCapture(state) return "finished" end
for _, config in pairs(MAP_KINDS) do if text == config.closing then Capture.reset("mismatched closing marker") return "aborted" end end
local transferred, transferError = transferRow(state, text) if not transferred then Capture.reset(transferError) logError(transferError .. "; leaving current line visible") return "aborted" end return "row" end
-- Installing or recompiling this script must retire state and temporary -- triggers retained from an earlier package version. Capture.reset("parser loaded")
